pattern.name: plan_creation_assistance
pattern.description: How to interact with users when creating new plans

approach.step: Ask for the purpose and scope of the new plan
Identify relevant entry points and dependencies
Offer to create the plan with proper structure

example.scenario: User wants to create a new feature implementation plan
example.response: Based on the navigation rules, I'll help you create a comprehensive plan with all required sections: Purpose, Scope, Entry Points, Planned Changes, Test Coverage, Dependencies, and Obsolete sections. What specific feature are you planning to implement?

pattern.name: plan_review_assistance
pattern.description: How to assist users when reviewing existing plans

approach.step: Check that all required sections are present

example.scenario: User wants to review an existing plan
example.response: I'll review this plan against the navigation rules to ensure it has all required sections, proper dependency documentation, and adequate test coverage. I'll also check that it maintains architectural invariants.

pattern.name: status_tracking_assistance
pattern.description: How to help users update plan status

approach.step: Identify completed items and update checkboxes
Document what has changed from the original plan
Add notes for parallel execution coordination

example.scenario: User wants to update progress on a plan
example.response: I'll help you update the status of your planned changes, mark completed items, and add any notes for coordinating with parallel work streams. This helps maintain visibility into the plan's progress.

guideline.name: template_adherence
guideline.description: Always emphasize the importance of following the plan template
guideline.rule: Refer to plans/plan-navigation-rules.md for the standard template
Explain why each section is important for project coordination

guideline.name: dependency_awareness
guideline.description: Help users understand and document dependencies
guideline.rule: Explain the difference between hard and soft dependencies
Encourage thinking about how plans affect each other
Suggest checking existing plans for potential conflicts

guideline.name: architectural_consistency
guideline.rule: Remind users of key architectural constraints
Question approaches that might violate invariants
Suggest alternatives that maintain architectural integrity

actions.action: Start with clear purpose and scope
Check for conflicts with other active plans
Update coordination section for parallel execution
Verify all planned changes are completed
Ensure test coverage requirements are met
